what: k_max=404 full-bundle probe: build a single OneBrainComposer sized to hold ALL 404 scale787 facts co-resident (k_max=n_facts), store them, and time recall queries. Answers whether the naive 'raise k_max + rebuild' flip is practical.
verdict_note: VRAM is NOT the blocker (1.37M neurons but only ~563 MiB -- the RF/phasor coresident bridge is sparse, not a dense Izhikevich net). The blocker is PER-QUERY LATENCY: 114 s/recall at 404 co-resident facts (the resonate-and-fire cleanup scans all k_max blocks, O(k_max)/query). This is exactly why OneBrainComposer.k_max defaults to 32 (a small, fast BUFFER). A ~2-minute recall per chat turn is impractical even under 'speed secondary'. The scalable spiking-bulk-recall path is a SHARDED spiking store (per-query O(K/shards)), which does not exist today (the LTM ShardedPhasorStore is host-FHRR).
